profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer at Precisely
profile.summary: As a self-initiating Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience in Enterprise web-based and Windows application development and real-time data warehousing, I’m supporting company Master Data Management (MDM) infrastructure, implementing new software, providing project management and systems administration; I’ve proven excellence in designing and supporting software applications for manufacturing, automotive, retail and financial industries. Utilizing my competencies and efficiency in C# / .Net development in usually a Microsoft ecosystem, I bring leadership, vision, accountability, prioritization and organization to any employer. My experience and background reveal outstanding development and design abilities, well rounded interpersonal skills, experience with full software development life cycle, logic and commitment to thrive in a diverse fast paced environment.

positions.title: Master Data Management Implementation Lead
positions.description:
- Supporting high profile clients in a multitude of industries while implementing new software solutions to resolve transform and improve their current industry technologies for their business production and technology advancement. 
- All projects included gathering functional requirements alongside business analysts to incorporate technical designs, documentation, technical design review, code reviews, knowledge transfer sessions, performance optimizations on the database as well as application layer
- Please see resume document above for full detail

Environment: Windows Server 2008 R2, Windows Server 2012, Apache 2.4, Tomcat, Open BD, MS SQL 2008 R2, MS SQL 2012,

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
- Implemented custom back office software solutions to comply with the ever-changing requirements of the mortgage industry from various government regulatory agencies
- Developed several new department specific applications, including a loan compliance auditing system. Utilizing HTML, CSS, SSI, AJAX, jQuery, and ASP, this web enabled application allowed authenticated back office users to fill out dynamically generated audits based off loan information in both the backend database and Calyx loan management system. The auditor utilized this information for generating risk management, payroll, reconciliation, and compliance reports required by governing entities
- Designed and developed a weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly payroll reporting system which would calculate production bonuses, net funds, transactions generated, and quality reports through consuming the auditing results. Additional development projects included a mail tracking system for the receiving department, lender management interfaces for lender relations to apply attributes extending the Calyx loan software functionality, recruit production tracking for recruiters, and a pricing engine for loan officers.
- Additional responsibilities included design and development of server code, configuring and upgrading all networked PCs, providing IT and loan origination software support to all remote and local employees, processing new hire packaging, managing lender accounts, and updating personnel licensing to comply with all NMLS, state, and national requirements.

Environment: MS SQL 2000, MS SQL 2005, Windows 2000, Windows Server 2003, Windows Server 2008 R2, CentOS 5

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed functionality for a multi-tenant storefront for both the frontend and administrative interface using an entity first approach with ASP.Net MVC 3 and the Razor engine. 
- Administrative functionality implemented included the ability for the owner to customize the storefront, set up pricing scenario matrices, define available options along with option groups per item offered, edit product metadata, and modify sales orders.
- Modified the frontend to support user registration, shopping carts, product searching, checkout capabilities, address verification, and basic templating.

positions.title: Implementation / Software Migrations / End User Trainer
positions.description:
- Implemented end to end software packages for automotive dealership data management
- Transformed existing data from legacy systems for import into the product data model for the associated parts modules implemented
- Assisted in financial data transformations and service data transformations as needed
- Assisted in preparing customized user documentation for user training
- Traveled on-site to administer hands on training for product training in parts management, services and other modules

Environment: Custom POWER workstations supported by a Mainframe running the COBOL application and GUI

positions.title: SAT Instructor
positions.description:
- Provided SAT instruction to TPR’s (The Princeton Review) students within our partnering school districts 
- Provided instruction (live and/or online) to students 
- Demonstrated a strong ability to improve students’ test scores and communicated students’ progress and success through the program

positions.title: Computer Science Department - Student Assistant
positions.description:
- Performed the initial set up and administration Windows 2000 and Windows 2003 servers
- Prepared test plans and data, along with a method for archiving student performance
- Problem-solved and troubleshooted hardware issues with fault-tolerant hard drives

volunteerExperiences.description:
Boy Scouts of America, San Antonio, Texas  www.scouting.org
The mission of the Boy Scouts of America is to prepare young people to make ethical and moral choices over their lifetimes by instilling in them the values of the Scout Oath and Law.
Scout Oath: On my honor I will do my best, To do my duty to God and my country and to obey the Scout Law; To help other people at all times; To keep myself physically strong, mentally awake, and morally straight. Scout Law, A Scout is: Trustworthy, Loyal, Helpful, Friendly, Courteous, Kind, Obedient, Cheerful, Thrifty, Brave, Clean, Reverent.

The Pet Patrol Mission, Houston, Texas www.thepetpatrol.org 
Pet Patrol, a people pet partnership, is a volunteer based, 501(c) (3) organization that recognizes the proven health benefits of companion animals and is dedicated to preserving the human-animal bond.  Our mission is to assist limited income elderly and those affected by chronic or life-threatening illnesses in the Houston area by helping our clients care for the pets with whom they share their lives. The unconditional love of a companion animal is a gift for countless thousands of people living with a challenging illness. Our animal companions provide love, diversion and a reason to get up in the morning. They also provide proven health benefits to their owners.
I volunteer every month, sorting out the deliveries for clients and coordinate care package for our clients. On Saturday, if a volunteer driver does not show up, I complete the necessary deliveries and drop off client orders in various locations throughout the greater Houston area. For the past two years, I also assisted in organizing and working four of our organizational fundraisers: Pennies for Pets, Howl-O-ween Costume Contest, Cookie Exchange, and the non-profit awareness booth at Reliant Park World Series Dog Show.

Boy Scouts of America, San Antonio, Texas  www.scouting.org
The mission of the Boy Scouts of America is to prepare young people to make ethical and moral choices over their lifetimes by instilling in them the values of the Scout Oath and Law.
Scout Oath: On my honor I will do my best, To do my duty to God and my country and to obey the Scout Law; To help other people at all times; To keep myself physically strong, mentally awake, and morally straight. Scout Law, A Scout is: Trustworthy, Loyal, Helpful, Friendly, Courteous, Kind, Obedient, Cheerful, Thrifty, Brave, Clean, Reverent.

The Pet Patrol Mission, Houston, Texas www.thepetpatrol.org 
Pet Patrol, a people pet partnership, is a volunteer based, 501(c) (3) organization that recognizes the proven health benefits of companion animals and is dedicated to preserving the human-animal bond.  Our mission is to assist limited income elderly and those affected by chronic or life-threatening illnesses in the Houston area by helping our clients care for the pets with whom they share their lives. The unconditional love of a companion animal is a gift for countless thousands of people living with a challenging illness.
